newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Congress approves $2 bln spending credit.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Congress approves $2 bln spending credit.

text.p: Venezuela's Congress approved Wednesday a 903 billion bolivar ($1.9 billion) government spending request to finance public sector wage rises, legislators said.
The unbudgeted request was approved less than a month after the cabinet sent it to Congress.

The cost of wage increases and recent labor reforms is expected to push Venezuela's 1997 budget to around 10.2 trillion bolivars ($21.1 billion) compared to original budget targets of 7.8 trillion bolivars.
The extra spending is to be financed by a newly revised tax declaration by state oil company PdVSA, gasoline sales taxes and extraordinary oil revenues from last year, ministers have said.
